<div style="text-align: center; padding-top: 2em;">
<br>
I am a cognitive psychologist pursuing a PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience at the <a href="https://mcn.unibas.ch/de/">University of Basel</a>, Switzerland and <a href="https://campuspress.yale.edu/cannonlab/">Yale University</a>, USA. My broad aim is to develop straightforward and scalable <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2666915323001658?via%3Dihub">treatment interventions</a> for mental health, using the potential of contemporary technologies, with a focus on immersive tech like AR and VR. 
</div> 
<div style="text-align: center; padding-top: 2em;">
This website serves as a personal time capsule and a platform for sharing my research and personal projects. <br>
